title: Binary mixed-dimension subspace code A_2(7,4)
confidence_basis: The radius-seven theorem is reconstructed by an independent no-import verifier using a different distance formula, union closure, and clique algorithm, then challenged by five fail-closed mutations. The 99% concerns the finite theorem; the global exact value remains unknown and the dated 334-388 frontier confidence is 96%.
summary: Certified that the exact maximum among all exchanges deleting at most seven planes from the specified Appendix C 333-plane code and adding arbitrary ambient subspaces is 334. This is a strict finite local result, not a determination of A_2(7,4); the searched global frontier remains 334-388.
